about: The owner's third grading batch, after his batch 2 voice note (Nov 9): more speeches, kinds mixed (never three of one kind in a row), variants of the moments he liked, and batch 2 moments he had not reached. In each moment the three lines are the slot's best, middle and worst by the grade map, so one grade teaches the most. Chosen by scripts/dialogue-batch/batch-three.ts. Grade it by voice note as before; scripts/dialogue-batch/voice-note-reader.ts reads it.
